scope: 50 characters; compiled native command rules, not unique moves; existing frozen ROM; no build

interpretation.hit_and_recovered: Entered expected destination, >2 HP damage and returned to idle without capture flags.
interpretation.input_missed: Expected destination not observed in tested contexts; another attack may have executed.
interpretation.no_impact_review: Entered; <=2 HP. Includes utility moves; not automatically a bug.
interpretation.conditional: Counter/reversal with <=2 HP; requires suitable context.
interpretation.grab_flag_leak: Both actors idle but capture flag persists; paired follow-up throw test confirms interference.

limitations: P1 facing right, opponent Kyo; no exhaustive matchup, MAX-mode, cancel or visual coverage.
